messages:
kiran: heads-up — during today's onprem maintenance (~00:30 UTC) a subset of private-controlplane admins got 403s and couldn't access VPC onboarding. Correlated with RBAC rollout (rbac-rewrite v2.2.3). Allowlist reload triggered and several admin bindings disappeared. @maria can you pick this up?

maria: on it. I saw a failed apply in the operator logs. Pushing a revert to canary now and filing a short incident.

dave: quick log snippet — KMS wrap/decrypt failed right before the allowlist reload; operator treated it like an auth failure and aborted reconcile which appears to have cleared bindings: 
```
2025-03-12T00:29:41Z ERROR operator/controller.go: applyBindings failed: kms: Decrypt failed: AccessDenied
2025-03-12T00:29:41Z INFO rbac/allowlist.go: reload triggered by configmap-change
2025-03-12T00:29:42Z ERROR rbac/sync.go: reconcile aborted: missing admin bindings for tenant acme-priv
```

jenna: FYI audit-bot flagged missing audit entries for that window. @audit-bot can you dump events for tenant=acme-priv 00:28-00:35?

audit-bot: @jenna requested events for tenant=acme-priv timeframe=2025-03-12T00:28:00Z..2025-03-12T00:35:00Z -> found configmap update -> rbac reload -> KMS error. No explicit roleBinding.delete events logged. Operator aborts seem to skip delete-event emission.

maria: rolling back the RBAC rollout on canary now — revert PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra-config/pull/3412 :thumbsup:

kiran: re-enable admin access via emergency job (kubectl apply -f emergency-admin-restore.yaml) for affected tenants. Created job: job/restore-admins-2321112222

dave: follow-up: I'll add a gating change so the operator does NOT prune bindings on transient KMS errors and adds retries. Will open PR shortly: https://github.com/redwood-inference/operator/pull/2789

jenna: also request we add a KMS integration healthcheck and an audit assertion that every binding removal has a matching audit log entry. Filing ENGSEC ticket ENGSEC-523 for verification and automated checks.

maria: postmortem draft is in #incidents. Short RCA: operator treated KMS Decrypt errors as auth failure and advanced the state machine which caused binding removals without audit emission. Fixes: KMS retries, fail-open for read-only checks, and explicit audit logging on reconcile aborts.

kiran: thanks all. tagging onprem-oncall @dave to verify after patch deploy. :eyes:
